output.question: Why does my tunnel on 5.1.5 keep resetting during phase 2 rekey when the peer offers more than one DH group?
output.reference_answer: This issue is seen on Nimbus NF-300 5.1.3 and 5.1.5 and corresponds to %IKEV2-3-PROPOSAL_MISMATCH (KB-3102). The responder accepts the child-SA proposal but caches the initiator's DH group in the rekey state machine; when the peer selects a different acceptable group on the next exchange, the local engine compares against the cached value and tears down the child SA. The workaround is to pin a single DH group, preferably group 14, on both peers and avoid mixed transform sets; the issue is fixed in 5.2.0.
